provenance.operatorDescription: Replaces the sharedTime the orchestrator passes in.
provenance.operatorRationale: sharedTime is the sole source of registerDate (SetCourtRegister/index.js:54 -> DateService.getLocalDateTime) and therefore of fileName (OutboundCourtRegister/index.js:34), of the `on` date the now-subscriptions query is made for (CourtRegisterSubscriptions/index.js:19 -> ReferenceDataService.js:35), and it is what defect C10 is about: getLocalDateTime formats the instant in Europe/London and then appends a literal "Z", so a British Summer Time instant is relabelled as UTC an hour out. The BST/GMT and midnight boundaries are exactly where a java.time port diverges by an hour or a day, and those variants are IN_CONTRACT parity obligations. The last five are not: cpp-context-results/results-event/results-event-processor/src/yaml/json/schema/public.hearing-resulted.json makes sharedTime required with format date-time, and the results context dereferences it unguarded, so an absent, null or unparseable sharedTime fails upstream of this service. Those recordings stand as robustness evidence, not obligations.

operatorDetail.why: 23:00 UTC in BST is 00:00 the NEXT day in London — registerDate and fileName roll over
